relations.subject: Noboru Karashima
relations.evidence: Noboru Karashima (辛島 昇, Karashima Noboru; 24 April 1933 – 26 November 2015) was a Japanese historian, writer and Professor Emeritus in University of Tokyo, Japan.

relations.subject: Noboru Karashima
relations.evidence: He also served as Professor Emeritus at the Taisho University, Japan.

relations.subject: Noboru Karashima
relations.evidence: President of the Epigraphical Society of India in 1985.
